title: crassula pellucida subsp. marginalis
intro: Crassula pellucida subsp. marginalis, commonly known as the Water Jade, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Crassulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in China and the Philippines, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Water Jade are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that may help in wound healing, antimicrobial infections, and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Water Jade may also exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
